So, $x$-intercept $=-\frac{a}{5}=\alpha$

questions.q: The function $f(x)=5+36 x+3 x^{2}-2 x^{3}$ is increasing in the interval

For increasing function, $f^{\prime}(x) \gt 0\Rightarrow \quad(x-3)(x+2) \lt  0\Rightarrow \quad x \lt  3$ and $x \gt -2\Rightarrow \quad-2 \lt  x \lt  3$
Hence, function $f(x)$ is increasing $\operatorname{in}(-2,3)$ interval.

questions.q: An open pipe immersed in water to half its length. The ratio of the fundamental frequency of the pipe before and after immersion in water is
questions.solution:
Let $L_{o}$ be the length of air column in pipe. After immersion,

L_{c}=\frac{L_{0}}{2}

Fundamental frequency in open pipe, $f_{o}=\frac{v}{2 L_{0}}$
Fundamental frequency in closed pipe, $f_{c}=\frac{v}{4 L_{c}^{r}}$
\therefore \quad \frac{f_{o}}{f_{c}}=\frac{\frac{v}{2 L_{o}}}{\frac{v}{4 L_{c}}}=2\left(\frac{L_{c}}{L_{o}}\right)=2\left(\frac{L_{o}}{2 L_{o}}\right)=1: 1

questions.solution:
Given, $\frac{I_{\max }}{I_{\min }}=9$
Since, intensity $\propto(\text { amplitude })^{2}\therefore \quad \frac{A_{\max }}{A_{\min }}=\frac{a_{1}+a_{2}}{a_{1}-a_{2}}=\sqrt{\frac{9}{1}}=\frac{3}{1}\Rightarrow \quad a_{1}+a_{2}=3 a_{1}-3 a_{2}\Rightarrow \quad 2 a_{1}=4 a_{2}\therefore \quad a_{1}: a_{2}=2: 1$

Time, $t=2 \mathrm{~min}=2 \times 60=120 \mathrm{~s}\therefore$ Power $=\frac{\text { Work done }}{\text { Time }}=\frac{W}{t}=\frac{120}{120}=1 \mathrm{~W}$
